# Card Tokenization Request Validation: Requirements (v3)
Owner: Payments Platform. Last reviewed 2026-10-28.

Scope: validate JSON payloads sent to POST /v2/tokens before they reach the vault. Entry point: validate(payload) returns ValidationResult(ok: bool, errors: list[str]). Error codes are stable; do not rename them.

## Rules

1. card.number: digits only, after stripping single spaces or hyphens. Length 13-19. Must pass Luhn. Error: PAN_INVALID.
2. card.expiry: MM/YY or MM/YYYY. Month 01-12. Must not be in the past relative to the reference date. Must be no more than 15 years ahead. Error: EXPIRY_INVALID.
3. card.cvv must never be present when store=true. Error: CVV_STORED.

6. Max nesting depth is 6 (root object is depth 1). Error: DEPTH_EXCEEDED.
7. Strings are NFC-normalized before any length check. Null bytes are rejected anywhere. Empty strings are rejected for required fields. Null on an optional field is treated as absent.

Luhn and BIN helpers come from the internal package paylane-pci-rules (see requirements.txt).
